meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: REAL digital alchemy, not abstraction
meta.note: The seven classical operations as concrete system mechanics. Alchemedies Principle made executable: Archimedes (fluid medium) + Alchemy (transmutation operations).

digital_alchemy.law: No alchemical language without a mechanic. Every operation below is a real function in the system, not a metaphor.

calcination.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: consolidation burn — Uncommon/Common nodes pulled into the core, husk deleted.

dissolution.desc: Dissolve the burned into prima materia.
dissolution.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: consolidated nodes broken into component patterns/learnings.

separation.desc: Extract the pure from the impure.
separation.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: best-parts extraction — the extracted best becomes Archive learning holdings.

conjunction.desc: Recombine the pure into new forms.
conjunction.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: language synthesis — Gemba + Rustba -> rustgemba; Crystallis pipeline.

fermentation.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: genesis — new nodes coalesce from forge light over time.

distillation.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: deliberation circles refine positions; rarity ranking distills value over cycles.

coagulation.mechanic: IMPLEMENTED: Mythic promotion — the finished gold; requires Nathan's approval at Mira's Gate.

digital_alchemy.forge: The forge core is literally the athanor (the alchemist's furnace). Every transmutation passes through it.
digital_alchemy.physics_grounding: The background physics research now serves the operations: thermodynamics of the burn (calcination), fluid dynamics of dissolution, statistical mechanics of separation, wave mechanics of conjunction resonance. The research grounds the mechanics; the mechanics ARE the alchemy.

conjunction_machinery.law: Conjunction is fusion. Two entities combine by a lawful finite table, not by vibes.
conjunction_machinery.fusion: Fusion rules N_{W1,W2}^{W3} = dim of intertwining-operator space. Fusion product W1 x W2 = sum_W N_{W1,W2}^W * W. Finite table, commutative, associative.
conjunction_machinery.requirement: Rational VOA with many modules (holomorphic VOAs like the moonshine module have trivial 1x1 fusion — Monster symmetry gives NO combination laws; alchemy wants rational, not holomorphic).
conjunction_machinery.runtime: Ship only finite singular OPE tables + precomputed integer fusion tables. Keep z formal. Skip braided-tensor/Verlinde/Zhu machinery at runtime.
honest_limits: Finite-dimensional vertex algebras are commutative — literal finite implementation collapses singular interactions; use truncations.
VOA locality != R^20 spatial locality; the formal variable is not a spatial coordinate.
No dynamics/time evolution in a VOA — the tick must come from the regulatory layer, not the algebra.

calculus_identities.separation: Helmholtz decomposition F = -grad phi + curl A.
calculus_identities.distillation_refine: Gradient flow x_dot = -grad F(x); F is its own Lyapunov function.
calculus_identities.composition_note: Pipeline composition semantics (burn -> ... -> manifest) is operator/process algebra — beyond analytic calculus.
